material.acceptance_criteria: Remote main rust/crates/data/src/lib.rs defines generate_preset and PRESETS; ci-status green for the pushed sha.
material.description: Add generate_preset(data_root, preset) in rust/crates/data/src/lib.rs. rts reads the root dir (unchanged default), moba and rpg read data_root/<name>; a missing dir or one with no .star errors. Owned path: rust/crates/data/src/lib.rs only. Relates to engine-preset-data-loader (blocker p5): root behaviour kept, so no consumer moves.
material.resolution: generate_preset(data_root, name) for rts, moba, rpg through the unchanged generate(); missing dir or unknown name is an error. Root rts default unchanged.
material.subject: Named preset loader entry: rts (root), moba, rpg through one generator
